reading.text:
UNIT def:LevyStochCalc.Brownian.augFiltration -- reading (locked before any Lean)

Paper notion: "the usual augmentation" (sec. 2) of a filtration (G_t): F_t = intersection over
s > t of sigma(G_s ∪ Null), Null = the P-null sets (of the completed F), so that (F_t) is complete
and right-continuous ("usual conditions"). Faithful Lean: a Filtration with F_t = sigma(G_t ∪
{P-null sets}) and right-continuity (either by the intersection over s > t, or by taking G_{t+}).
Representation choices that are acceptable: (a) Lean's ambient sigma-algebra is not complete,
so only measurable null sets (or null sets of the ambient sigma-algebra) can be adjoined -- this
is harmless for a.s./expectation statements; (b) omitting right-continuity is harmless IN THE
PAPER'S SETTING because the augmented filtration generated by a Levy process (W, N) and an
independent F_0 is automatically right-continuous (Blumenthal-type 0-1 law), but it is a
representation choice that must be recorded. Not faithful: adjoining non-null sets, or using the
un-augmented filtration where completeness is needed (e.g. for adaptedness of a.s. limits /
versions).

Paper context (sec. 2, sec. 3, sec. 4, App. A). Standing basis: (Omega,F,(F_t),P) satisfying the usual
conditions, horizon T>0, d-dimensional Brownian motion W and an independent Poisson random
measure N on R_+ x E with intensity dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a countably generated (E,E);
(F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent initial
sigma-field F_0. Stochastic integrals int Z dW (Z in H^2_W: R^{m x d}-valued predictable,
E int_0^T |Z|_F^2 dt < oo) and int int U dNtilde (U in H^2_N) are the L^2 (Ito /
compensated-Poisson isometry) integrals; they are true L^2 martingales, cadlag, and are used in
identities holding a.s. for every t (sec. 3, "solution"). The paper never constructs these
integrals itself: it takes the standard construction (Applebaum sec. 4, He-Wang-Yan). So every
unit below is infrastructure: the paper's notion is the textbook one, and a faithful Lean
definition is one that (together with the other definitions) yields the textbook object on the
paper's basis for every integrand the paper's claims use; junk values outside that class are
harmless only if every proposition restricts to the class.

comparison.text:
Comparison: def:LevyStochCalc.Brownian.augFiltration (AugmentedFiltration.lean:51-57)

Reading: usual augmentation F_t = intersection_{s>t} sigma(G_s ∪ Null); acceptable choices: only
ambient-measurable null sets; omitting right-continuity if recorded (automatic for the paper's
generated filtration). Not faithful: adjoining non-null sets.
Lean: augFiltration F mu : t |-> aug (F (max t 0)) (ambient) mu, where aug m m0 mu = the
m0-measurable sets A with mu(A Δ B) = 0 for some B in m (= m ⊔ sigma(m0-measurable mu-null sets),
aug_eq_sup_nullSigma). So:
- null-set augmentation: YES, by the ambient-measurable null sets only. For ambient-measurable
  sets this coincides with augmentation by the completion's null sets (if A in m0 and
  A Δ B is contained in a null set, then mu(A Δ B) = 0), so nothing is lost for any statement
  about ambient-measurable processes; non-null sets are never adjoined.
- right-continuity: NOT included in augFiltration itself. Every use of the paper's filtration
  applies it to a right-continuous version first: enlJoint = augFiltration (initJoint).rightCont P
  (and enlBrownian likewise), the library proves the result right-continuous
  (isRightContinuous_augFiltration), and aug commutes with the countable decreasing infimum
  (aug_iInf_of_antitone), so aug(G_{t+}) = intersection_{s>t} aug(G_s), the usual augmentation.
- freezing before time 0: F_t = aug(F_0) for t <= 0; the paper has no negative times, and the
  propositions' processes vanish off [0,T] or are considered on [0,T] only. Harmless.
- W stays Brownian (isBrownianFiltration_augFiltration).
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Choices: (1) Each sigma-algebra is joined with the ambient-measurable mu-null sets (Lean's ambient
sigma-algebra need not be complete); on ambient-measurable sets this equals augmentation by the
null sets of the completion, so no statement about measurable processes changes. (2) Right
continuity is not part of augFiltration; the paper's usual augmentation is built by the
consumers as augFiltration of the right-continuous version (enlJoint, enlBrownian), which equals
intersection_{s>t} aug(G_s) by aug_iInf_of_antitone and is right-continuous. (3) The filtration is
frozen before time 0 (time index R); the paper's time set is [0,T], so negative times carry no
content.
